contentText: Tensions rise between Guinea and Burkina Faso after Conakry bans Burkinabe broadcaster RTB, amid a diplomatic dispute over gold miners and a caricature of President Mamadi Doumbouya. Meanwhile, fighting erupts between Congolese forces and the Rwanda-backed FRN group in eastern DR Congo, despite peace commitments. Finally, in Ethiopia, one entrepreneur is tackling period poverty by breaking menstrual stigma and making reusable sanitary pads more accessible.
